name: orders_custidx
parts: orders: I64 [mode, kmin]: index mode (1: dense directory) and smallest key
orders: U32 directory offsets into the permutation, one per key kmin + e (mode 1), nkeys + 1 entries
orders: U32 permutation of canonical orders rows grouped by o_custkey (mode 1)
orders: I64 per-row keys (mode 0 fallback only; empty in mode 1)

layout.summary: A secondary index of orders on o_custkey: a dense directory over the key range [kmin, kmin + nkeys) whose entry e is a range of a permutation of the canonical orders rows; the range holds exactly the rows whose o_custkey is kmin + e (so its length is their number).
layout.units: keys are bigint o_custkey values; offsets are positions in the permutation (U32); permutation entries are canonical orders row numbers (U32)
